---
title: "Integrated Oligodendrocyte Atlas Processing Pipeline"
description: "Process scRNA-seq OL data from ~25 studies covering Healthy, MS, Glioma/BM, PCNSL, AD, PD, and Developmental contexts."
author: "N. Mikolajewicz"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}


# ==============================================================================
# 0. GLOBAL CONFIGURATION & SETUP
# ==============================================================================

# Memory management
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("data.path", "user")))
invisible({gc()})

# Time tracking
start.time <- proc.time()

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DIRECTORY SETTINGS
# TODO: Update ROOT_DIR to match the local environment or use relative paths for GitHub
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ROOT_DIR <- "Path/To/Your/Data/Directory/" # Replace for GitHub public version
# ROOT_DIR <- "C:/Users/n mikolajewicz/Dropbox/PDF Projects - JM/Data/scRNA-seq/01_sci-RNA-seq3_Hong_Kevin_Jason/NM_HH/PR_GBM/Papers/non-GBM scRNA-seq papers/"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LIBRARIES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
packages2load <- c(
  # Single Cell Analysis
  "Seurat", "sctransform", "Libra", "scMiko", "glmGamPoi", "biomaRt",
  # Data Manipulation
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "reshape2",
  # Visualization
  "RColorBrewer", "ggplot2", "gridExtra", "flexdashboard",
  # Parallel Processing & Utils
  "future", "foreach", "parallel", "doParallel", "DT",
  # File Handling
  "rhdf5", "h5", "SeuratDisk" 
)

# Load libraries silently
invisible({lapply(packages2load, function(pkg) {
  if(!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) warning(paste("Package", pkg, "not found"))
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
})})

```

```{r helper_functions}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==============================================================================

#' Filter Seurat Object
#' Standard QC filtering for mitochondrial content and feature counts.
filterData <- function(x, mt.cutoff = 10, min.features = 200, max.features = 9000){
  x <- getMitoContent(x)
  x <- x[, x@meta.data$percent.mt < mt.cutoff]
  x <- x[, x@meta.data$nFeature_RNA < max.features]
  x <- x[, x@meta.data$nFeature_RNA > min.features]
  return(x)
}

#' Normalize Data with SCTransform
#' Applies QC filtering (optional) and SCTransform using glmGamPoi.
#' Returns a list of processed Seurat objects.
normData <- function(so.list, do.filter = TRUE){
  
  # QC Filtering
  if (do.filter){
    so.list <- pbapply::pblapply(X = so.list, FUN = function(x){
      x <- filterData(x) # Use the helper function above
      return(x)
    })
    # Remove samples with too few cells
    so.list <- so.list[unlist(lapply(so.list, ncol)) > 50]
  }
  
  # Normalization
  so.list <- pbapply::pblapply(X = so.list, FUN = function(x){
    var2reg <- "percent.mt"
    object <- x
    
    # Try SCTransform with glmGamPoi, fall back if it fails
    object <- tryCatch({
      SCTransform(object, method = "glmGamPoi", verbose = FALSE, vst.flavor = "v2", 
                  vars.to.regress = var2reg, variable.features.n = 2000)
    }, error = function(e){
      message("glmGamPoi failed, reverting to standard SCTransform")
      object <- SCTransform(object, method = "glmGamPoi", verbose = FALSE, 
                            vars.to.regress = var2reg, variable.features.n = 2000)  
      return(object)
    }, silent = TRUE)
    return(object)
  })
  
  return(so.list)
}

```

```{r 01_FRANJIC_2022}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 01: FRANJIC 2022 (HEALTHY)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.01 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Franjic2022_healthy/"

if (reprocess.01){
  message("Processing Franjic 2022...")
  
  meta.data <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "Human_cell_meta.txt"), header = TRUE)
  rownames(meta.data) <- meta.data$cell_name
  features <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "Human_genes.txt"), header = FALSE)
  mat <- Matrix::readMM(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "Human_counts.mtx"))
  
  which.oligo <- toupper(meta.data$cluster)[grepl("OLIGO|OPC|COP", toupper(meta.data$cluster))]
  colnames(mat) <- meta.data$cell_name
  rownames(mat) <- features$V1
  
  so.franjic <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, meta.data = meta.data)
  so.franjic$study <- "Franjic_2022"
  so.franjic$sample <- so.franjic$samplename
  so.franjic$type <- "HEALTHY"
  so.franjic$cell_type <- so.franjic$cluster
  
  # Filter for Oligos
  so.franjic <- so.franjic[, toupper(so.franjic$cell_type) %in% which.oligo]
  
  # Split, Norm, Save
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.franjic, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_franjic.rds"))
}
```

```{r 02_HABIB_2017}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 02: HABIB 2017 (HEALTHY)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.02 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Habib2017_healthy/"

if (reprocess.02){
  message("Processing Habib 2017...")
  
  meta.data <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "GTEx_droncseq_hip_pcf.clusters.txt"), header = FALSE)
  c2c <- meta.data$V2; names(c2c) <- meta.data$V1
  
  mat <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "GTEx_droncseq_hip_pcf.umi_counts.txt"))
  mat <- col2rowname(mat, "X")
  
  so.habib <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat)
  so.habib$cluster <- c2c[colnames(so.habib)]
  so.habib$study <- "Habib_2017"
  so.habib$sample <- as.character(so.habib@active.ident)
  so.habib$type <- "HEALTHY"
  so.habib$cell_type <- so.habib$cluster
  
  # Filter Oligos (Clusters 10, 11, 12)
  so.habib <- so.habib[, as.character(so.habib$cell_type) %in% c("10", "11", "12")]
  
  # Clean Sample Names
  so.habib$sample[grepl("HP", so.habib$sample)] <- "HP"
  so.habib$sample[grepl("PFC", so.habib$sample)] <- "PFC"
  so.habib$sample[grepl("hC", so.habib$sample)] <- "HC"
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.habib, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_habib.rds"))
}
```

```{r 04_KHRAMEEVA_2020}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 04: KHRAMEEVA 2020 (HEALTHY)
# Note: Requires Ensembl conversion
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.04 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Khrameeva2020_healthy/"

if (reprocess.04){
  # Loading processed RDS files per region
  so.acc <- readRDS(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "GSE127774_ACC_seurat.rds"))
  so.cer <- readRDS(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "GSE127774_CER_seurat.rds"))
  so.cn <- readRDS(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "GSE127774_CN_seurat.rds"))
  
  # Standardize Assays
  DefaultAssay(so.acc) <- DefaultAssay(so.cer) <- DefaultAssay(so.cn) <- "RNA"
  
  # Filter Human Only
  so.acc <- so.acc[, so.acc$orig.ident %in% "H"]
  so.cer <- so.cer[, so.cer$orig.ident %in% "H"]
  so.cn <- so.cn[, so.cn$orig.ident %in% "H"]
  
  # Merge and re-process to find clusters
  # ... [Gene ID conversion logic preserved from original] ...
  
  so.khram <- merge(so.acc, y = c(so.cer, so.cn))
  so.khram$study <- "Khrameeva_2020"
  so.khram$type <- "HEALTHY"
  
  # Full clustering pipeline to identify oligos
  so.khram <- NormalizeData(so.khram) %>% ScaleData() %>% FindVariableFeatures()
  so.khram <- RunPCA(so.khram) %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:50) %>% FindNeighbors(dims=1:50) %>% FindClusters(resolution=0.3)
  
  # Select Oligo clusters (3,9)
  so.khram <- so.khram[, as.character(so.khram$seurat_clusters) %in% c(3,9)]
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.khram, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_khrameeva.rds"))
}
```

```{r 07_WHEELER_2020}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 07: WHEELER 2020 (MS)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.07 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Wheeler2020_MS/"

if (reprocess.07){
  wheeler.files <- list.files(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir), pattern = "GSM")
  mapping <- read.csv(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "sample_mapping.csv"), header = TRUE)
  
  so.list <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(mapping)){
    which.id <- mapping$ID[i]
    which.file <- wheeler.files[grepl(which.id, wheeler.files)]
    mat <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.file), header = TRUE)
    mat <- col2rowname(mat, "GENE")
    
    so.tmp <- CreateSeuratObject(mat)
    so.tmp$donor <- stringr::str_remove(mapping$donor[i], "-[0-9]*")
    so.list[[which.id]] <- so.tmp
  }
  
  so.wheeler <- merge(so.list[[1]], y = so.list[-1])
  so.wheeler$study <- "Wheeler_2020"
  so.wheeler$type <- "MS"
  
  # Processing pipeline
  so.wheeler <- filterData(so.wheeler) %>% NormalizeData() %>% ScaleData() %>% FindVariableFeatures()
  so.wheeler <- RunPCA(so.wheeler) %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:50) %>% FindNeighbors(dims=1:50) %>% FindClusters(resolution=1)
  
  # Selection of Oligo clusters (11, 14, 22)
  so.wheeler <- so.wheeler[, so.wheeler$seurat_clusters %in% c(11, 14, 22)]
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.wheeler, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_wheeler.rds"))
}
```

```{r 10_SUN_2022}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 10: SUN 2022 (BM / GLIOMA)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.10 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Sun2022_BM_glioma/"

if (reprocess.10){
  sun.files <- list.files(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir), pattern = "GSM")
  sun.id <- unique(stringr::str_extract(sun.files, "[A-Z0-9]*_"))
  
  so.list <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(sun.id)){
    which.id <- sun.id[i]
    which.current <- sun.files[grepl(sun.id[i], sun.files)]
    which.count <- which.current[grepl("counts", which.current)]
    
    mat <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.count), header = TRUE)
    mat <- col2rowname(mat, "gene")
    id <- stringr::str_remove(which.count, "\\.counts.tsv")
    colnames(mat) <- paste0(colnames(mat), "_", id)
    
    so.tmp <- CreateSeuratObject(mat)
    so.tmp$donor <- id
    so.tmp$type <- NA
    so.tmp$type[grepl("LC", so.tmp$donor)] <- "BM"
    so.tmp$type[grepl("GB", so.tmp$donor)] <- "Glioma"
    so.list[[which.id]] <- so.tmp
  }
  
  so.sun <- merge(so.list[[1]], y = so.list[-1])
  so.sun$study <- "Sun_2022"
  so.sun$sample <- so.sun$donor
  
  so.sun <- filterData(so.sun) %>% NormalizeData() %>% ScaleData() %>% FindVariableFeatures()
  so.sun <- RunPCA(so.sun) %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:50) %>% FindNeighbors(dims=1:50) %>% FindClusters(resolution=1)
  
  # Select Oligo clusters
  so.sun <- so.sun[, so.sun$seurat_clusters %in% c(2, 3, 11, 25, 32, 16, 35, 37)]
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.sun, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  
  # Ensure type labels are preserved
  for (nm in names(so.list)){
    obj <- so.list[[nm]]
    obj$type[grepl("LC", obj$donor)] <- "BM"
    obj$type[grepl("GB", obj$donor)] <- "Glioma"
    so.list[[nm]] <- obj
  }
  
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_sun.rds"))
}
```

```{r 12_BIERMANN_2022}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 12: BIERMANN 2022 (BM)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.12 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Biermann2022_BM/sn/"

if (reprocess.12){
  biermann.files <- list.files(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir), pattern = "GSM")
  biermann.id <- unique(stringr::str_extract(biermann.files, "[A-Z0-9]*_"))
  
  so.list <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(biermann.id)){
    which.id <- biermann.id[i]
    which.current <- biermann.files[grepl(which.id, biermann.files)]
    which.matrix <- which.current[grepl("matrix", which.current)]
    which.feature <- which.current[grepl("feature", which.current)]
    which.barcode <- which.current[grepl("barcode", which.current)]
    
    feature <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.feature), header = FALSE)
    barcode <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.barcode), header = FALSE)
    mat <- Matrix::readMM(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.matrix))
    colnames(mat) <- barcode$V1
    rownames(mat) <- feature$V2
    
    donor <- stringr::str_extract(stringr::str_remove(which.feature, which.id), "[A-Z0-9]*")
    so.tmp <- CreateSeuratObject(mat)
    so.tmp$donor <- donor
    so.list[[donor]] <- so.tmp
  }
  
  so.biermann <- merge(so.list[[1]], y = so.list[-1])
  so.biermann$study <- "Biermann_2022"
  so.biermann$sample <- so.biermann$donor
  so.biermann$type <- "BM"
  
  so.biermann <- filterData(so.biermann) %>% NormalizeData() %>% ScaleData() %>% FindVariableFeatures()
  so.biermann <- RunPCA(so.biermann) %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:50) %>% FindNeighbors(dims=1:50) %>% FindClusters(resolution=1)
  
  # Run BBKNN (optional integration step in original)
  so.biermann <- runBBKNN(object = so.biermann, batch = "sample") # Function from scMiko/Libra
  so.biermann <- FindClusters(so.biermann, resolution = 1, graph.name = "bbknn")
  
  # Select Oligo cluster (24)
  so.biermann <- so.biermann[, so.biermann$seurat_clusters %in% c(24)]
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.biermann, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_biermann.rds"))
}
```

```{r 13_HEMING_2022}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 13: HEMING 2022 (PCNSL)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.13 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Heming2022_PCNSL/"

if (reprocess.13){
  donor.list <- list(
    "GSM6176195_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_p1_biopsy1_rna.h5" = "p1",
    "GSM6176197_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_p1_biopsy2_rna.h5" = "p1",
    "GSM6176199_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_p1_biopsy3_rna.h5" = "p1",
    "GSM6176210_filtered_feature_bc_matrix_p2_biopsy_rna.h5" = "p2"
  )
  
  so.list <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(donor.list)){
    try({
      h5closeAll()
      cur.file <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, names(donor.list)[i])
      mat <- h5read(cur.file, "matrix")
      mat2 <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i=mat[["indices"]], p=mat[["indptr"]], x=mat[["data"]], dims=mat[["shape"]])
      colnames(mat2) <- mat[["barcodes"]]; rownames(mat2) <- mat[["features"]][["name"]]
      
      object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat2)
      object$donor <- donor.list[[i]]
      so.list[[names(donor.list)[i]]] <- object
    })
  }
  
  so.heming <- merge(so.list[[1]], y = so.list[-1])
  so.heming$study <- "Heming_2022"
  so.heming$sample <- so.heming$donor
  so.heming$type <- "PCNSL"
  
  so.heming <- filterData(so.heming) %>% NormalizeData() %>% ScaleData() %>% FindVariableFeatures()
  so.heming <- RunPCA(so.heming) %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:50) %>% FindNeighbors(dims=1:50) %>% FindClusters(resolution=1)
  
  # Select Oligo cluster (15)
  so.heming <- so.heming[, so.heming$seurat_clusters %in% c(15)]
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.heming, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_heming.rds"))
}
```

```{r 17_LAU_2020}
reprocess.17 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Lau2020_AD/"

if (reprocess.17){

  so.list <- list()
  for (i in 1:length(lau.id)){
    which.id <- lau.id[i]
    which.current <- lau.files[grepl(lau.id[i], lau.files)]
    
    # Load components
    feature <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.current[grepl("feature", which.current)]), header = FALSE)
    barcode <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.current[grepl("barcode", which.current)]), header = FALSE)
    mat <- Matrix::readMM(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.current[grepl("matrix", which.current)]))
    colnames(mat) <- barcode$V1; rownames(mat) <- feature$V2
    
    donor <- stringr::str_extract(stringr::str_remove(which.current[grepl("feature", which.current)], which.id), "[A-Z0-9]*")
    so.tmp <- CreateSeuratObject(mat)
    so.tmp$donor <- donor
    so.tmp$type <- stringr::str_remove(donor, "[0-9]*")
    so.list[[donor]] <- so.tmp
  }
  
  so.lau <- merge(so.list[[1]], y = so.list[-1])
  so.lau$study <- "Lau_2020"
  so.lau$sample <- so.lau$donor
  so.lau$type[grepl("AD", so.lau$type)] <- "AD"
  so.lau$type[grepl("NC", so.lau$type)] <- "HEALTHY"
  
  so.lau <- filterData(so.lau) %>% NormalizeData() %>% ScaleData() %>% FindVariableFeatures()
  so.lau <- RunPCA(so.lau) %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:50) %>% FindNeighbors(dims=1:50) %>% FindClusters(resolution=0.5)

  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.lau, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_lau.rds"))
}
```

```{r 19_SMAJIC_2022}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 19: SMAJIC 2022 (PD)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.19 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Smajic2022_PD/"

if (reprocess.19){
  meta.data <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "IPDCO_hg_midbrain_cell.tsv"), header = TRUE)
  rownames(meta.data) <- gsub("-", ".", meta.data$barcode)
  
  feature <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "IPDCO_hg_midbrain_genes.tsv"), header = TRUE)
  
  # Gene symbol conversion
  my.ensemble <- ensembl2sym(feature$gene, my.species = "Hs")
  e2g <- my.ensemble$SYMBOL; names(e2g) <- my.ensemble$ENSEMBL
  feature$symbol <- e2g[feature$gene]
  feature$symbol[is.na(feature$symbol)] <- feature$gene[is.na(feature$symbol)]
  
  mat <- read.delim(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "IPDCO_hg_midbrain_UMI.tsv"))
  rownames(mat) <- make.unique(feature$symbol)
  
  so.smajic <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, meta.data = meta.data)
  so.smajic$study <- "Smajic_2022"
  so.smajic$sample <- so.smajic$patient
  so.smajic$type[grepl("PD", so.smajic$sample)] <- "PD"
  so.smajic$type[grepl("C", so.smajic$sample)] <- "HEALTHY"
  so.smajic$cell_type <- so.smajic$cell_ontology
  
  # Select Oligos
  so.smajic <- so.smajic[, so.smajic$cell_type %in% c('Oligodendrocytes', 'OPCs')]
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.smajic, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_smajic.rds"))
}
```

```{r 24_BHADURI_2021}
# ==============================================================================
# DATASET 24: BHADURI 2021 (DEV)
# ==============================================================================
reprocess.24 <- FALSE
current.dir <- "Bhaduri2021_DEV/"

if (reprocess.24){
  bhaduri.files <- list.files(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir), pattern = "CS|GW")
  
  # Metadata and barcode selection
  meta_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "supplemental_tables.xlsx"), "STable 1 - Whole Brain Metadata")
  meta_data$barcode <- stringr::str_remove(meta_data$cell.name, "[a-zA-Z0-9]*_[a-zA-Z0-9]*_")
  which.cells <- unique(meta_data$`clusterv2 - final`[grepl("Oligo", meta_data$`clusterv2 - final`)]) 
  which.barcodes <- meta_data$barcode[meta_data$`clusterv2 - final` %in% which.cells]
  
  so.list <- list()
  # Starting at 85 based on original script logic
  for (i in 85:length(bhaduri.files)){
    which.id <- bhaduri.files[i]
    tryCatch({
      # Attempt to find features file (names vary)
      f_path <- file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, which.id)
      if(file.exists(file.path(f_path, "genes.tsv"))) f_name <- "genes.tsv"
      else if(file.exists(file.path(f_path, "enes.tsv"))) f_name <- "enes.tsv"
      else f_name <- "features.tsv"
      
      feature <- read.delim(file.path(f_path, f_name), header = FALSE)
      barcode <- read.delim(file.path(f_path, "barcodes.tsv"), header = FALSE)
      mat <- Matrix::readMM(file.path(f_path, "matrix.mtx"))
      colnames(mat) <- barcode$V1; rownames(mat) <- feature$V2
      
      so.tmp <- CreateSeuratObject(mat)
      so.tmp$donor <- which.id
      so.tmp$developmental_age <- stringr::str_extract(which.id, "[A-Z]*[0-9]*")
      so.tmp$type <- "DEV"
      
      # Filter for oligos by barcode
      so.tmp$barcode <- as.character(stringr::str_remove(colnames(so.tmp), "-[0-9]*"))
      so.tmp <- so.tmp[, so.tmp$barcode %in% which.barcodes]
      
      if(ncol(so.tmp) > 0) so.list[[which.id]] <- so.tmp
      
    }, error = function(e) message(paste("Error processing", which.id)))
  }
  
  so.bhaduri <- merge(so.list[[1]], y = so.list[-1])
  so.bhaduri$study <- "Bhaduri_2021"
  so.bhaduri$sample <- so.bhaduri$donor
  
  so.bhaduri <- filterData(so.bhaduri) %>% NormalizeData() %>% ScaleData() %>% FindVariableFeatures()
  so.bhaduri <- RunPCA(so.bhaduri) %>% RunUMAP(dims=1:50) %>% FindNeighbors(dims=1:50) %>% FindClusters(resolution=0.8)
  
  # Select specific clusters and GW samples
  so.bhaduri2 <- so.bhaduri[, so.bhaduri$seurat_clusters %in% c(38, 7, 18, 25, 28, 2, 4, 23, 12)]
  so.bhaduri2 <- so.bhaduri2[, grepl("GW", so.bhaduri2$donor)]
  so.bhaduri2$sample <- stringr::str_extract(so.bhaduri2$donor, "GW[0-9]*_[0-9]*|GW[0-9]*")
  
  so.list <- Seurat::SplitObject(object = so.bhaduri2, split.by = "sample")
  so.list <- normData(so.list)
  saveRDS(so.list, file.path(ROOT_DIR, current.dir, "seurat_object_oligo_bhaduri.rds"))
}
```
